news.headline: Crude firm: WTI $94.88 (+0.8%), Brent $106.50 (+0.8%)
news.what_happened: Oil extended gains for a second straight session with Brent holding above $106.
news.why_it_matters: Elevated crude is a cost headwind for airlines, paints and tyres and supports upstream realisations (ONGC, OIL).

news.headline: US markets flat-to-slightly lower; US 10Y yield at 5.22%
news.what_happened: S&P 500 -0.08%, Nasdaq -0.15%; 10Y Treasury yield at ~5.2%, a very high level.
news.why_it_matters: No strong risk-on cue for India; high US yields keep FII flows under pressure.

news.headline: Nifty closed +0.89% at 22,722; Asia mixed (Nikkei +0.56%, Hang Seng flat)
news.what_happened: Nifty rallied yesterday despite persistent FII selling; Asian cues are muted today.
news.why_it_matters: Last verified FII data (7 Oct) showed ~Rs 6,121 Cr net selling vs DII buying ~Rs 4,597 Cr; October FII selling is ~Rs 20,300 Cr so far. Latest day's flows could not be verified.

sector_outlook.reason: Rupee at 95.28 supportive but Nasdaq slightly down
US 10Y 5.2% and FII selling offset Nifty strength

picks.logic: Upstream realisation per barrel rises with crude; ONGC has direct P&L exposure. Modest target sized to a typical single-session move.

risks: GIFT Nifty and latest FII/DII data could not be verified - confirm the opening gap before entering
